descriptor.retrieval_description: Cylindrical aluminum beverage can with a painted exterior coating. The intended contact region is dry, smooth, with continuous cylindrical curvature and no visible seams.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral sidewall of the can at the center grasp band
descriptor.contact_material: Painted aluminum coating over metal substrate
descriptor.local_geometry: Cylindrical curvature with continuous smooth surface
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the upper and middle lateral surfaces
descriptor.uncertainty: The back side of the can is occluded, but the visible lateral grasp band provides standard cylindrical contact characteristics.
